authority: Direct user clarification: carbon is agreed; align graphite/carbon across every asset to be produced

dark_paint.rule: Use one agreed carbon paint color; graphite describes a surface appearance, not another palette color.

families.jet: Use carbon paint for any authorized future carbon/graphite refinement. Preserve approved lacquer appearance and existing accepted images; no additional jet work scheduled.
families.lift: Unify original and repaired carbon boom, casing, chassis, spreader and stair/landing frames. Preserve separate blue, metal, rubber and glass.
families.containers: Apply carbon only to explicitly selected dark carbon/graphite paint or fittings. Preserve agreed silver identity concept and separately selected navy/blue containers.
families.truck: Use carbon for dark tractor/chassis, structural paint and any graphite parts. Preserve separately reviewed blue, metal, rubber and glass.
families.freight_ship: Use carbon for the graphite hull portions and painted carbon structures. Preserve separately reviewed steel-blue hull portions and silver/navy/blue deck containers.
families.editorial_architecture: Use carbon for authored carbon/graphite surfaces; preserve natural silver/titanium and approved blue lighting.
families.atmosphere: Ocean, clouds, lighting and shadows keep their scene palette; do not treat them as painted carbon surfaces.

surface_policy: Base color does not lock roughness, metalness, normal texture or coat. Agree these in the relevant physical material review.
Glossy jet lacquer, satin structural paint, brushed metal and rubber retain their distinct physical properties.
Parts intended to share one carbon finish must share material settings and texture density; do not introduce color variants to compensate for lighting.
Rendered highlights and shadows naturally vary around the agreed base color.
production_rules: Read PROPOSAL.md and this contract before every family or asset production batch.
Resolve carbon/graphite wording in the locked prompt book to #11151B by including the mandatory prompt clause below in every relevant reviewed generator prompt.
Include exact material-role mapping in each family proposal; review genuinely unspecified non-carbon paints/finishes before generation.
Reject unapproved graphite/dark-paint hex additions; show carbon/porcelain review before acceptance.
Preserve earlier approved assets, requests, manifests and GLBs. Their existing values are provenance, not future instructions.
mandatory_prompt_clause: All painted carbon or graphite surfaces use Pegasoft carbon #11151B as their shared base paint color. Graphite describes the material appearance; do not introduce a separate grey-blue paint variant. Preserve the separately approved blue, brushed silver/titanium, rubber and glass material roles. Natural highlights and shadows come from lighting, not different paint colors.
locked_prompt_book: ASSET-PROMPTS.md remains unchanged; PROPOSAL.md and this contract supply the binding exact-color interpretation for future execution.
